disclaimer: This corpus is a demonstration artifact, not a clinical reference. It holds two freely licensed US federal sources chosen to exercise retrieval and citation for one scripted scenario. It is not complete, not current by design, and must never be used to make or justify a clinical decision.

excluded_passages.text: the A1C goal is 7% or less
excluded_passages.reason: Tier B threshold claim, inadmissible twice over under F07 §3.7: a clinical target from a patient-education source, and a population-averaged claim ("for most people with diabetes") that does not transfer to an individual patient. Recorded so the exclusion stays deliberate and reviewable; the build fails if it is ever indexed.
